manufacturing-quality-control.title: Smart Quality Control for Manufacturing
manufacturing-quality-control.desc: AI vision system developed for a large manufacturer to replace manual inspection.
manufacturing-quality-control.full_desc: Computer vision-based intelligent quality inspection system developed for a large manufacturing enterprise, replacing traditional manual inspection and improving detection accuracy and efficiency.
manufacturing-quality-control.challenge: Traditional manual inspection is inefficient, subjective factors affect accuracy, and it becomes a bottleneck as capacity increases.
manufacturing-quality-control.solution: Deep learning-based CV solution, multi-station auto image acquisition, edge real-time inference, millisecond response.

smart-retail-recommendation.title: Smart Retail Recommendation Engine
smart-retail-recommendation.desc: Deep learning analyzed user data to build high-precision personalized recommendations.
smart-retail-recommendation.full_desc: Leverage deep learning to analyze massive user behavior data, build high-precision personalized recommendation systems, and significantly improve conversion rates.
smart-retail-recommendation.challenge: Large online traffic but low conversion, manual recommendation cannot achieve individual personalization.
smart-retail-recommendation.solution: Deep reinforcement learning recommendation system, integrating history, real-time path and inventory.

results.label: Conversion
results.desc: User click and purchase intent enhanced

predictive-maintenance-wind-farm.title: Predictive Maintenance for Wind Farms
predictive-maintenance-wind-farm.desc: Real-time monitoring of turbine status via sensors to predict potential failures.
predictive-maintenance-wind-farm.full_desc: Real-time monitoring of wind turbine status through sensor data, predicting potential failures and optimizing maintenance costs through AI scheduling.
predictive-maintenance-wind-farm.challenge: Remote wind turbines have high repair costs after failure, and unplanned downtime causes huge losses.
predictive-maintenance-wind-farm.solution: IIoT sensors for vibration, temperature, and acoustics, using time-series models to predict failures 7-14 days ahead.

results.label: O&M Cost
results.desc: Shifted from repair to demand maintenance

results.label: Asset Life
results.desc: Extended life of core transmission parts

fintech-risk-assessment.title: AI-Driven FinTech Risk Assessment
fintech-risk-assessment.desc: Improving loan approval accuracy and speed using deep learning on alternative data.
fintech-risk-assessment.full_desc: Implemented a deep learning framework for a leading digital bank to assess credit risk using non-traditional data points, achieving faster approvals and lower default rates.
fintech-risk-assessment.challenge: High manual overhead in credit scoring and rising default rates among new-to-credit customers.
fintech-risk-assessment.solution: Neural network models analyzing transactional behavior and social graphs, integrated with existing banking core.

logistics-route-optimization.title: Intelligent Logistics Route Optimization
logistics-route-optimization.desc: Reducing fuel consumption and delivery times with AI-powered dynamic routing.
logistics-route-optimization.full_desc: Developed a dynamic routing engine for a national logistics provider, utilizing real-time traffic data and weather patterns to optimize vehicle paths.
logistics-route-optimization.challenge: Rising fuel costs and customer demands for shorter delivery windows in urban areas.
logistics-route-optimization.solution: Genetic algorithms and reinforcement learning models deployed on the edge for drivers.

precision-agriculture-yield.title: Precision Agriculture AI for Crop Yield
precision-agriculture-yield.desc: Using satellite imagery and AI to optimize fertilizer usage and predict harvests.
precision-agriculture-yield.full_desc: An end-to-side AI system monitoring crop health via multi-spectral satellite imagery to provide precision farming prescriptions.
precision-agriculture-yield.challenge: Unclear soil health variations leading to over-fertilization and inconsistent yields.
precision-agriculture-yield.solution: Computer vision models identifying early signs of pests and nutrient deficiencies from orbit.

smart-education-personalized.title: AI-Powered Personalized Learning
smart-education-personalized.desc: Adaptive learning platform tailor-making education paths for K-12 students.
smart-education-personalized.full_desc: Creating a customized learning environment that adjusts difficulty and content based on individual student performance and engagement metrics.
smart-education-personalized.challenge: One-size-fits-all curriculum leading to low engagement and uneven learning outcomes.
smart-education-personalized.solution: Knowledge graph-based recommendation engine tracking micro-competencies.

smart-grid-management.title: Smart Energy Grid Management
smart-grid-management.desc: AI forecasting for load balancing and renewable energy integration.
smart-grid-management.full_desc: Implementing a demand-side management system for a metropolitan power grid to stabilize load during peak hours using predictive AI.
smart-grid-management.challenge: Grid instability due to fluctuating solar/wind input and unpredictable EV charging loads.
smart-grid-management.solution: Ensemble time-series models for short-term load forecasting and automated battery dispatch.

real-estate-valuation-ai.title: CV-Based Real Estate Valuation
real-estate-valuation-ai.desc: Automating property appraisal with computer vision and market trend analysis.
real-estate-valuation-ai.full_desc: System analyzing street-view and indoor photos to estimate property value with human-level accuracy for insurance and mortgage providers.
real-estate-valuation-ai.challenge: Expensive and slow manual appraisals; high variance in subjective valuations.
real-estate-valuation-ai.solution: Multi-modal model combining image features with geographic and topological data.

media-sentiment-analysis.title: AI Sentiment Analysis for Global Media
media-sentiment-analysis.desc: Real-time tracking of brand perception across multiple languages and platforms.
media-sentiment-analysis.full_desc: Natural Language Processing (NLP) system monitoring thousands of news sources and social media streams to detect emerging public opinion shifts.
media-sentiment-analysis.challenge: Unable to keep up with the volume of global discourse; delayed response to PR crises.
media-sentiment-analysis.solution: Multi-lingual BERT models with entity-level sentiment tracking and anomaly alerting.

hotel-guest-experience.title: Smart Hotel Guest Experience Automation
hotel-guest-experience.desc: AI concierge and room automation for premium guest satisfaction.
hotel-guest-experience.full_desc: Deployment of AI-powered conversational systems and IoT room controls for a luxury hotel chain to personalize stay experiences.
hotel-guest-experience.challenge: Labor shortages in hospitality and rising guest expectations for digital-first service.
hotel-guest-experience.solution: Voice-enabled AI concierge integrated with PMS and smart home devices in-room.

drone-powerline-inspection.title: Autonomous Drone Inspection for Power Lines
drone-powerline-inspection.desc: AI-guided drones detecting damage in high-voltage grids without human control.
drone-powerline-inspection.full_desc: A fully autonomous edge-AI system for BVLOS (Beyond Visual Line of Sight) inspection of transmission towers and cables.
drone-powerline-inspection.challenge: Dangerous and expensive helicopter/manual tower climbs; large inspection backlog.
drone-powerline-inspection.solution: Edge deep learning on NVIDIA Orin, real-time defect detection for insulators and dampers.

results.label: Inspection Speed
results.desc: Covers more grid in less time

Pricing.title: Pencil Pen Importer
Pricing.subtitle: Seamlessly import .pen design files into Figma. Preserve layers, styles, and layouts with pixel-perfect accuracy.

features.title: Why Pencil Pen Importer?
features.subtitle: Bridge the gap between Pencil and Figma with a powerful, reliable import tool.

import.title: One-Click Import
import.desc: Import .pen files directly into Figma with a single click. No manual recreation needed.

styles.title: Style Preservation
styles.desc: Colors, gradients, typography, and effects are accurately mapped to Figma equivalents.

layout.title: Layout Fidelity
layout.desc: Auto-layout, constraints, and component hierarchy are maintained during import.

plans.title: Simple, Transparent Pricing
plans.subtitle: Choose the plan that fits your workflow. Start free, upgrade when you need more.

free.name: Starter
free.desc: Perfect for trying out the plugin and small projects.

features.f1: Import up to 5 files per month

pro.name: Pro
pro.desc: For professionals and teams who need unlimited power.

q1.a: .pen is the native file format used by Pencil, a modern UI design tool. The Pencil Pen Importer allows you to bring these designs into Figma without losing any detail.

q2.q: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
q2.a: Yes. You can cancel your Pro subscription at any time. You'll continue to have access until the end of your current billing period. See our Refund Policy for details.

q3.a: The Starter plan includes 5 file imports per month with basic style preservation. For unlimited imports and advanced features, consider upgrading to Pro.

q4.q: How do I install the plugin?
q4.a: Click the 'Install Free on Figma' button to visit the Figma Community page. From there, click 'Try it out' to add the plugin to your Figma workspace.

About.hero_subtitle: From AI vision to real-world impact — learn what drives WSAI forward.
About.story_title: Building the Future of Enterprise AI Since 2019
About.story_p1: Shanghai Weicheng Info Tech (WSAI) was founded in 2019 with a clear mission: make powerful AI accessible to every business. Starting from a small office in Jing'an District, our founding team — a group of AI researchers and seasoned enterprise architects — saw a gap between cutting-edge research and practical business applications.
About.story_p2: Today, WSAI serves clients across manufacturing, finance, retail, logistics, and more. We have delivered over 50 successful AI projects, helped enterprises reduce operational costs by an average of 35%, and built long-term partnerships rooted in trust and measurable results.
About.story_p3: We are not just a technology vendor. We are strategic partners who understand your industry, speak your language, and stay with you from initial consultation through deployment and beyond.
